inputs.text: The “8 million” figure and more than 3,300 events are coming from organizers, then being echoed by AFP—not from an official count. That’s the point: make the opposition look enormous, leave the numbers impossible to check, and let the image do the work. The claim of a million more people and 600 more events than in October may be less a measure of public feeling than a carefully amplified message about how much pressure people are supposed to believe exists. When the same interested parties supply the numbers and shape the story, skepticism is warranted.

output.main_topic: Skeptical assessment of organizers’ figures for opposition turnout and events
subtopics: Figures attributed to organizers and echoed by AFP
